title: Quarterly roadmap: Dedicated capacity experiments and autoscale ops runbook
creator: Anika Patel
description: Purpose: Define a compact quarterly roadmap that pairs a small set of controlled experiments (to reduce unit cost) with an operational runbook that on-call and SRE teams can use during autoscale events. Focus areas: 1) reservation blending experiments (mix of reserved + burst pools), 2) graceful-degradation lanes for best-effort requests, 3) budget-aware prewarm windows to reduce cold-start latency while controlling spend. This ticket covers planning, cross-team alignment, telemetry spec, and an ops playbook template for handoffs and simulated failure drills.
goals: Reduce median token cost for experimental workloads by 18% within the quarter
Keep 99th percentile latency impact under 15% during canary rollouts
Ship a one-page on-call runbook and run two simulated failure drills with oncall within cycle
success_metrics: Runbook adoption: at least 2 teams sign off and use in 2 drills
milestones: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with ENG, SRE, Billing, and Support
2026-03-15: First reservation-blend experiment live in canary pool
2026-03-29: Ops runbook v1 published and stakeholder walkthrough
rollout_plan: Start with a 5% traffic canary using a blended reservation + burst policy. Monitor token-level cost and tail latency on the dedicated pools dashboard. If metrics remain within guardrails for 48h, step to 25% for a 72h soak. Maintain automatic fallback to baseline model variant and cross-region routing if provisioning fails. Tie a budget throttle to the experimental pool to prevent runaway spend.

acceptance_criteria: Telemetry spec merged and dashboard panels visible to stakeholders
Runbook v1 reviewed by SRE and oncall and published to Confluence

Post-drill action items tracked and prioritized in Linear
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: experimental pools cause unexpected token-cost spikes - Mitigation: hard budget throttle and immediate fallback policy
Risk: P99 latency regressions during scale - Mitigation: progressively increase canary % and maintain KV cache pinning for the baseline path
Risk: cross-team coordination gaps - Mitigation: weekly 30-minute sync and a dedicated Slack channel (#pm-dedicated-autoscale)
Risk: oncall unfamiliar with new runbook - Mitigation: two tabletop drills prior to public rollout
